result.cluster_label: Moral outrage with insulting taboo language
result.definition: KEEP posts in this cluster use moral/rights-based outrage framing while pairing it with contemptuous insult or taboo/harsh labeling toward an opposing group or supporters.
result.salience_notes: The co-occurrence of normative rights language with dismissive profanity or dehumanizing descriptors signals an aggressive, contempt-driven rhetorical stance rather than neutral critique.
